decisions.subject: MX-3360
decisions.summary: MX-3360 held regulation at 70C ambient with 8C junction margin on PSM-28 Rev 2; bench check only, not a TP-PSM-07 qualification

evidence.quote: MX-3360 on a PSM-28 Rev 2 board, sealed enclosure, 3 A load. Held regulation at 70C ambient with 8C junction margin.
This is a bench check. It is not a TP-PSM-07 qualification, and cold-start behaviour with firmware sequencing was not tested.
